title: Vikram and Betal: The Clever Girl

scenes.summary: Betal tells a story about a clever girl.
scenes.text: Betal told Vikram about a clever girl who lived with her mother.
scenes.image_prompt: vikram carrying betal in forest cartoon style

scenes.text: A rich man accused the girl of stealing his ring.
scenes.image_prompt: rich man accusing girl angrily cartoon

scenes.text: The girl suggested giving everyone a stick to reveal the truth.
scenes.image_prompt: girl explaining idea in court cartoon

scenes.text: All sticks remained the same, showing no one was guilty.
scenes.image_prompt: people holding same size sticks cartoon

scenes.text: The king realized the rich man was lying. Vikram said the girl was clever, and Betal flew away.
scenes.image_prompt: king praising girl while betal flies away cartoon

story: A clever girl was falsely accused of theft. She suggested a smart test to reveal the truth. The king realized she was innocent. Vikram praised her intelligence, and Betal flew away.
